cycles.weakness_identified: Lack of contextual understanding in self-referential statements
cycles.optimization_proposal: Incorporate a 'self-reflection' prompt in 10% of self-referential statement training examples, asking the AI to paraphrase or summarize its own previous responses.

cycles.weakness_identified: Lack of self-reflection mechanisms for meta-cognitive awareness
cycles.optimization_proposal: Implement a 'meta-reasoning' task in 20% of self-reflection prompts, where the AI is asked to justify its previous decisions or thought processes.
